description: Land Acquisition - Rambukoluwa, Laggala D/S Division, Matale District - Amendment Extraordinary Gazette No. 2011/22 dated 23.03.2017, Cadestral No. 510609 Block - 09
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes (Morgahakanda and Kaluganga Development Project), including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The notices also include information about compensation claims and public hearings related to the land acquisitions. This fits squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisitions, property descriptions, and land registration matters.
